can.runs: prove -l t (or make test, ./Build test, dzil test)

facts.kind: Test::More or Test2 tests in t/*.t

action-pinning.message: all 6 actions are pinned to a commit

ci-lint.message: CI lints its configuration (GitHub Actions: actionlint, zizmor)

ci-present.message: CI configuration found for GitHub Actions

code-formatting.message: .perltidyrc is defined and CI runs perltidy

compiler-warnings.message: strict Perl pragmas and lints are enabled: use strict and use warnings in every module, perlcritic

copy-paste-detection.message: CI runs copy-paste detection with jscpd

coverage.message: branch coverage is reported with Devel::Cover; path coverage bonus: Devel::Cover

dependency-audit.message: CI audits the dependencies with cpan-audit

dependency-updates.message: automated dependency updates are configured with Dependabot

function-limits.message: function length is limited with lizard

large-files.message: no committed file is larger than 5 MiB

license.message: the project is licensed under MIT

platform-matrix.message: CI covers 3 OS(es) (linux, macos, windows), 2 Perl version(s) (5.38, 5.40), 6 combination(s)

secret-scanning.message: secrets are scanned for with gitleaks

security-policy.message: SECURITY.md says how to report a vulnerability

status-badges.message: README.md shows CI (GitHub Actions) and quality (Codecov) badges

vcs-ignore.message: .gitignore ignores blib/; .gitignore ignores MYMETA.*; .gitignore ignores local/; .gitignore ignores cover_db/

warnings-as-errors.message: warnings are treated as errors with Test::Warnings in the tests
